meta.name: City of Dreams
meta.description:
An assassination attempt on Mumbai's most powerful politician triggers a dirty game of power and politics in the Gaikwad family.  With his son and daughter racing to the throne, lines between moral and immoral blur and a lot is at stake

Rated TV-MA · Ended · First aired 3 May 2019 · India · Language: Hindi · 45 min
Studio: Applause Entertainment, Kukunoor Movies · Network: Disney+ Hotstar

Complete series. On your server: S1 10/10 | S2 10/10 | S3 9/9

videos.title: The Shoot-Out
videos.overview: An assassination attempt on Mumbai’s political stalwart Ameya Rao Gaikwad stuns the city. As the family deals with the shock, his son Ashish takes centre stage, while 'Encounter' Wasim gets on the case, unofficially. Suitable for viewers 15+

videos.title: The Response
videos.overview: With his personal life in a mess, Wasim gets a lead on one of the shooters. Meanwhile, Ashish spins out of control and a concerned Jiten asks Poornima to take charge. Suitable for viewers 15+

videos.title: The Rift
videos.overview: Poornima tries to persuade Ashish to consult her before making any decision, which doesn't go down well with him. Meanwhile, Wasim keeps the hunt on in his own inimitable style. Suitable for viewers 15+

videos.title: The Hunt
videos.overview: When Ashish crosses the line, Poornima confronts him. On the other hand, Wasim tries to change the game with the trump card in his hand. Suitable for viewers 15+

videos.title: The Decision
videos.overview: Ashish makes a shocking confession to Shireen. Later, a furious Poornima opens up to Lipakshi. Suitable for viewers 15+

videos.title: The Black Book
videos.overview: Poornima turns the table on Ashish's rally. Elsewhere, Wasim gets closer to the assassin, while Jiten hides the black book. Suitable for viewers 15+

videos.title: The Mastermind
videos.overview: Consumed by power and politics, Poornima's relationship with Kaushik begins to crumble. Wasim meets an old informant and finds a crucial lead. Suitable for viewers 15+

videos.title: The Awakening
videos.overview: Scrambling for political support, Poornima tries hard to find her normal, while CM Jagdish gets into an unexpected alliance. Suitable for viewers 15+.

videos.title: The Betrayal
videos.overview: Taking advantage of the situation, Jagdish makes his way to Delhi while Poornima learns the truth about the attack and the perpetrators. Suitable for viewers 15+

videos.title: The Victory
videos.overview: In the lead up to the grand party meeting, matters come to a head. Someone will win and someone will lose. Suitable for viewers 15+

videos.title: The Contender
videos.overview: As Poornima takes over as the CM and leader of MJS with the support of Gurav and Wasim, a deadly disaster challenges her reign. Meanwhile, Ameya comes out of his convalescence.

videos.title: The Raid
videos.overview: Purushottam's mystery woman is revealed to have a dubious connection with Gaikwad. Poornima unleashes hell on Mehka Infra.

videos.title: Moment of Truth
videos.overview: Shireen makes a bold move that causes a media frenzy. Gaikwad begins to regroup and sets his plan in motion.

videos.title: Skeletons in the Closet
videos.overview: Ramnik meets Poornima to negotiate for Mehka Infra. Gaikwad visits a long-forgotten person from Poornima's past and makes him an offer he can't refuse.

videos.title: The Offer
videos.overview: Wasim discovers not only a conspiracy to disrupt the elections but also Nambiar's weakness. However, Poornima's problems begin when Gaikwad plays his trump card.

videos.title: The Prophecy
videos.overview: As the world gets more curious about Poornima and Mahesh's relationship, she ventures out to seek answers. At the same time, Tanya finally shows Arvind her world.

videos.title: The Great Debate
videos.overview: While Poornima challenges Mahesh to a live debate, Purushottam asks Wasim's help for Asha. Meanwhile, a sinister plan is brewing in the city.

videos.title: The Truce
videos.overview: With Purushottam held hostage and Poornima's family life in turmoil, the CM meets a despondent Mahesh. Elsewhere, Tanya confronts Arvind about Mehka Infra and the bridge collapse.

videos.title: The Unforgiving
videos.overview: When Gurav's past catches up to him in the news, Sone Maa advises him to face his demons. In the meantime, Poornima meets Jagan to rescue Purushottam.

videos.title: Collateral Damage
videos.overview: As Gaikwad prepares for his comeback, Poornima is all set to inaugurate the Mumbai metro project. However, both father and daughter pay a heavy price in their game of power.

videos.title: Where is Poornima Gaikwad?
videos.overview: Amidst unrest in the MJS party, Ameya Rao Gaikwad, the interim CM, seeks the help of reinstated cop Wasim Khan to find Poornima, who has been missing for over three months.

videos.title: Homecoming
videos.overview: Despite battling anxiety and alcohol addiction, Poornima accepts her fate and returns home with Wasim. Asha runs out of options. Gaikwad and Vibha's relationship goes sour.

videos.title: Reconciliation
videos.overview: While Poornima struggles to get back to her normal life, Wasim joins the Drugs Task Force. As she and her father mend fences, Kasturinath plans a big exposé on Gaikwad.

videos.title: The Drug Syndicate
videos.overview: Wasim starts cracking down on the drug syndicate. Vibha and Adarsh join hands. With Poornima preparing her comeback as the CM, Gaikwad faces the media.

videos.title: Character Assassination
videos.overview: Gurav conspires with Vibha and Kadam to plan a coup against the Gaikwads, in which Poornima takes a hit. Danny's grandmother welcomes Angie into their home.

videos.title: The Truth
videos.overview: Poornima reveals her truth to the world. Danny has a surprise for Angie. Gaikwad tries to reconcile with Jagan.

videos.title: Skeletons In The Cupboard
videos.overview: Gaikwad's past comes back to haunt him as Gurav sets up another plan with the help of Kadam and Badivdekar. Meanwhile, Jagan has something big up his sleeve.

videos.title: The Offer
videos.overview: As Wasim walks into a trap set for him, the Gaikwads try their best to lure back the defecting MLAs. An angry Pinchoo confronts Danny. Asha calls Wasim with important information.

videos.title: Good Vs Evil
videos.overview: Wasim finally reveals to Poornima who he has kept hidden in a safe house. When the Gaikwads are on their way to Satara, Jagan makes his move.
